lineages.head: r16-head-1
lineages.name: Desk Terminal, Banded, merged
culled: ONE LIT LINE: a single lit line from the screen (the tube, the typed question) down into the list's 'now' marker, a real wire from the live thing to the next thing due.
set labels in small caps with +0.08em tracking
make the primary button's ground a grounded deep green and keep the bright green for its label and halo
drop the footer's legend strip and leave the lamp and the page name
hang the thread from a thin rail with Vera's mark at the top and the family's lines on the other side
push this one step further, as the same idea made more of: give every other row the faintest ground band
set headings in a serif from the library and keep labels in the mono
set the section's count as a large light numeral with its unit in small caps beside it

kept.text: Green-black glass, steel-slate case and thin lines in amber and violet, with the least neon in the field
mark the current page in the bar with a short rule under it instead of a pill
Select drawn as a raised button with a chevron that flips open; a clean list; bright Send key

lineages.head: r16-head-2
lineages.name: Track Diagram Aglow, merged
culled: end every section's rule with a small solid end mark
draw a short trace (a sparkline of the last seven days) beside each count
move one section colour (the one currently nearest the green) a step towards slate
set labels in small caps with +0.08em tracking
show the ways to start as a column of keys beside the box on wide screens
let the glass fold to a single Ready line whenever nothing is live

kept.text: large typed count figure beside the plate with brass unit and a pencilled line; or 48px title with the page's one action at the right end; Page title plate with a large typed count and unit beside it
add one line of status under the question in the machine's mono voice (what she is doing now)
shift the ground one step cooler and the neutrals one step warmer
Fraunces titles and section heads, light lining figures, small-caps units; Fraunces heads with light lining figures and small-cap units; a larger page title with the action at its end
push this one step further, as the same idea made more of: put the question's own words as the thread's first line

lineages.head: r16-head-3
lineages.name: Long Persistence Tallied, merged
culled: put the question's own words as the thread's first line
A SECTION-HEAD RULE WITH AN END MARK on every page.
make the NOW marker a lit tick on the list's rail with the time beside it
draw checkboxes as small lit squares, off as an empty frame
draw a short trace (a sparkline of the last seven days) beside each count
drop the footer's legend strip and leave the lamp and the page name
round every box and panel one step less
push this one step further, as the same idea made more of: A COUNT STRIP under the page head, 'Today · Plans 4 · To do 4 · Late 3 · Ideas 12', each count a link to its page.
type the question on the glass one size smaller and keep the cursor blinking only while focused
set the section's count as a large light numeral with its unit in small caps beside it

kept.text: Status gauge on the glass with tick scale, lit needle and a big mono readout; or an ECG scope trace
One mono lamp line saying what Vera is doing ('Ready, nothing waiting on Vera'); a steel dot for waiting in place of red
set the select menus as a plain button that opens a list, with a chevron

culled: A SECTION-HEAD RULE WITH AN END MARK on every page.

set the composer as a one-line tube docked at the foot
slightly cooler ground with warmer bone neutral words; walnut and brass plate material as runner
draw 'waiting' as a steel dot and 'off' as a pewter ring, nothing red

push this one step further, as the same idea made more of: end every section's rule with a small solid end mark
add the layered halo to the live list's lit words only, and nothing else
give every other row the faintest ground band
